item.title: Sae Joon Park, a Purple Heart veteran who self-deported, receives pardon
item.description: His removal order was triggered by two convictions from over 15 years ago, when he struggled with untreated PTSD. New York's governor said Park earned a "second chance through rehabilitation."

item.title: After 6 months of war, Iran's battered regime remains entrenched
item.description: Instead of collapsing, the Iranian regime has dug in its heels and taken an even harder line.

item.title: Fed's Kevin Warsh warns inflation is too high, sparking bets rate hikes are coming
item.description: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated his commitment to fighting inflation in a major speech — raising expectations that rate hikes may be coming, though he did not clearly spell out a path going forward.

item.title: New Jersey is a fossil hotspot, with answers about the day the dinosaurs died
item.description: Paleontologist Ken Lacovara never expected to find critical fossil data in a New Jersey suburb—let alone info about the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs. His dig site is now a fossil park and museum.

item.title: Experts warn more flooding might hit Nepal. And, Fed chairman to give key address
item.description: As the death toll rises from flash floods that hit the Nepal-Tibet border, experts are warning more flooding could be on the way. And, Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh is expected to give a key address today.

item.title: 'It's essentially been one long day': A daughter details search for parents in Nepal
item.description: Shreya Ahuja is searching for her parents after devastating floods struck Nepal. She is calling for international help and communications access as her family waits for news.

item.title: 4 ways to cope with constant thoughts about your body image
item.description: Obsessing over your looks should not take up all your energy, says psychologist Diana Hill. If you're struggling with uncomfortable thoughts about your body, ground yourself with these techniques.
